caption: The drawing depicts a rooster figurine composed of various colors and details. The rooster has a prominent red comb and wattle, with brown and dark gray tones covering its body, neck, and wings, and intricate feather patterns etched on the tail and wings. Its beak is yellowish, and the eye is small and dark. The figurine sits atop a green base that has streaks of red and yellow, resembling grass or terrain. The overall drawing has a plain, beige background with the words "Beverly Chichester" written to the lower right of the rooster.
title: Toy Bank: Rooster
